title: feat(studio): the generic item page's Save takes effect at once; an AI draft gets the designers' notice and discard
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTuMGhLAZx29zwDrayDGZZF)_
Fixes #36902

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在 Studio 的通用详情页（钩子、选项集、视图等）改完点「保存」，改动立刻生效；不再有自动保存开关，也不用再点一次「发布」。
- 为什么做：Studio 重构专题里「通用详情保存即生效」这一项，让通用详情和各个设计器的保存方式一致。
- 出错会怎样：发布被拒时，页面上方写明原因，什么都不生效，页面上的修改保留可以再存；AI 留下的草稿保留并有提示，可以一键放弃；本改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

Studio's generic item page (`ResourceEditPage`, every type without its own designer: hook, picklist, view, page, app, doc…) now saves the way the designers do (#36511, epic decisions 1, 12, 14).

1. **Save = draft + this one item's publish.** Save writes the draft (`PUT /meta/:type/:name?mode=draft`, If-Match / If-None-Match pin and conflict dialog unchanged), then publishes that one item (`POST /meta/:type/:name/publish`) at the same `?package=` and bundle `member`. The publish is pinned to the published version the page loaded, through the existing `DraftSaveGuard.publish` (#36601), so a Save over a row another editor published since opens the same conflict dialog (reload, overwrite, keep editing). The auto-save switch, its 1.5 s debounce and the `metadata-admin:autosave` browser setting are gone; the header's Publish and discard-draft buttons are gone.
2. **Create publishes after its first save** (If-None-Match `*`, then the publish).
3. **AI draft** (`draftChanges[].by` is `copilot` or `mcp`): the page shows the AI's version under the designers' `StudioAiDraftNotice`; a person's Save makes it live together with their edits; "Discard the AI's changes" drops that one item's draft at its package and member, and asks first (in the page's own dialog, objectui#13333) when the page holds unsaved edits.
4. **A person's pending draft** from before this change is marked "This item has unpublished changes" with its own Publish (pinned) and Discard for that one item.
5. **Leave guard**: ×, ‹ ›, the side menu, in-app links, reload and close ask first when the page holds unsaved edits; browser Back is not intercepted (decision 12). The seam was already in place (`chrome/unsavedEdits.ts`); this PR pins it on this page.
6. **A refused publish** shows its reason above the editor in the designers' words (`publishRefusal`, server text under Details). Nothing goes live; the draft the Save wrote is taken back when no draft was pending before, and the edits stay on the page, unsaved. A draft that was pending before (the AI's or a person's) is kept.
7. **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `MetadataClient.layered()` now forwards `overlayVersion`.** The client rebuilt its answer field by field and dropped it, so a publish pin read off `layered()` was always `null`. This is why the Save's publish could not be pinned; it also made the object page's #36601 publish pin a no-op on a server that serves the field. Fixed in place (bounded fix: same defect class as the card's pin, mechanical, the file had no other claim, no new gate surface) and pinned in `metadata-client.layeredDraft-29793.test.ts`. **Clause-② yes (widening):** the published package's exported `MetadataLayered` type gains the optional member `overlayVersion?: string | null` (claim amendment on #36902, 7137741670; L1-b (3) S1, 7137721696).

New shared piece: `detailSaveAtOnce.ts` (`publishDetailSave`, `isAiDraft`). The designers' `publishSavedItem` (`studioSaveBar.tsx`) names no bundle member, so this page carries its own instead of changing that file. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `DraftConflictDialog.tsx` and `studioSaveBar.tsx` are unchanged (reused as they are).

### How this relates to #36726 and #36350

- **#36726** (open PR #36958 pins the designers' publish): no shared files, either PR can land first. This card pins the generic page's own publish with the same #36601 `DraftSaveGuard` API, used as it is on main. The `overlayVersion` client fix (item 7) is what makes a pin read off `layered()` effective at all, the object page's included. One sequencing item: #36958 adds rule 9 to the guard (a reload over a draft that was pending before the Save keeps the conflict's pin until the author re-confirms), answered by a `beforeReload` that returns `'kept'`. On main that callback is typed to resolve to nothing (a void promise) and refuses that answer (tsc TS2345, measured), so it cannot be written here without editing `DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, which this card must not touch. Today this page is at parity with main's guard. Whichever PR lands second adds the one-line `beforeReload` for the `hadDraft` case in `publishDetailSave`.
- **#36350** (view-draft publish takes a draft-version precondition): left to #36350. That is a change to the publish door (server / protocol), outside this card's boundary (Metadata-protocol: none). This page's publish is pinned on the published version, not on the draft version, so the window #36350 describes (another writer's draft write between this Save's draft save and its publish, then published by this Save) is still open for views until #36350 lands. When it does, the Save's publish can send the draft version it just received; the call site is `publishDetailSave`.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ResourceEditPage.tsx` `doSave`: the draft save → `publishDetailSave` → refresh sequence, and the refused branch (take-back only when `hadDraft` is false).
2. `detailSaveAtOnce.ts`: the take-back on a refused or conflicted publish.
3. `metadata-client.ts` `layered()`: the two `overlayVersion` forwards.

### Two-minute check

Open Studio → All metadata → any view, change its label, press Save. Expected: one `PUT …?mode=draft` and one `POST …/publish` in the network panel, the Unsaved chip clears, no "unpublished changes" line, and `GET /api/v1/meta/view/NAME` already serves the new label.

## Tests

### Acceptance run (the card's 验收 scenario, real browser, self-built stack)

Backend `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) and the console dev server, both built from this branch, on per-agent ports. The items are my own, authored into the showcase's customization package (`com.example.showcase.custom`): a hook, a shared option set (picklist) and two views. The backend ran with `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=picklist`: the picklist type is not runtime-creatable by default (`NOT_CREATABLE`, its registry entry), so the option-set leg needs that operator setting. Each leg edits the label and presses Save once; the network log is the page's own requests.

| Item | Before Save | Writes after Save | Live read after Save |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook `s36902_stamp_title` | chip `unsaved`, no request in 2.5 s | `PUT …?mode=draft&package=…custom` then `POST …/publish?package=…custom` (200) | new label served; no unpublished-changes line |
| picklist `s36902_priority` | same | same pair (200) | same |
| view `showcase_task.s36902_triage` | same | same pair (200) | same |

**AI draft.** Written through the real MCP door, not faked: an OAuth client (dynamic registration, PKCE, consent, `metadata:write`) called `save_metadata_draft` on `showcase_task.s36902_ai`; the draft read then carried `draftChanges: [{path: ["label"], by: "mcp", …}]`.
- The page shows the AI's version under the notice (4). An edit then "Discard the AI's changes" asks in the page's own dialog (5); confirming sends one `DELETE …?state=draft&package=…custom`, the draft read answers 404 and the live version is back (6).
- A second MCP draft, then an edit and Save: `PUT` draft + `POST …/publish` (200), the draft read answers 404, the live label is the AI's change plus the person's edit (7).
- Leave guard: with an unsaved edit, × asked "You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?", and Cancel stayed on the item.

### Live e2e

`LIVE_APP_URL=… LIVE_API_URL=… pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.live.config.ts e2e/live/studio-detail-save-at-once.spec.ts e2e/live/studio-editor.spec.ts`: 3 passed (the new spec: no auto-save in 2.5 s, × asks, Save sends exactly `PUT` + `POST …/publish`, the live page has the added block, the draft read is 404, browser Back is not intercepted; `studio-editor.spec.ts`'s Add-block round trip now reads the published item after Save).

### Unit

At head `09693db5c`, under the shared verify lock, one run: every test file under `metadata-admin/` plus every other ui test file that mentions publish, draft, auto-save or the detail page (338 files), then `type-check` (which compiles the test files too) of `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

```text

```

New: `ResourceEditPage.saveAtOnce-36902.test.tsx` (19 cases over the real `MetadataClient` and an in-memory server that honours If-Match / If-None-Match on the draft door and on the publish door: items 1–6, the leave guard on ×, ‹ ›, links, beforeunload, Back unguarded, create publishes, refused create). `metadata-client.layeredDraft-29793.test.ts` gains the `overlayVersion` forward on both answer shapes (served value, served null, absent).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- 'Changes 1' in shots 1–3 is the AI draft of `showcase_task.s36902_ai`, written through MCP before the save leg for shots 4–7; it clears in shot 6 once that draft is discarded (not the hook: its Save sent `PUT ?mode=draft` then `POST /publish` 200).

- Existing detail-page suites that waited out the auto-save or clicked the header's Publish / Discard draft now press Save and read the Save's own publish, or use the unpublished-changes line's buttons (14 files). Their doubles gained a publish that drains the draft, as the real door does; assertions that only held because a draft stayed pending after Save were rewritten to the live result. `layersUnsaved-11799`'s SAVE case now expects one `/layers` re-read: a Save publishes, so the item has a layer afterwards.
- Leftover `localStorage.setItem('metadata-admin:autosave', '0')` lines in suites this PR does not otherwise touch are now no-ops; left as they are to keep the diff to the card.
- The platform checklist step that says the ResourceEditPage draft auto-saves and is then published (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, the page Add-block item) is now stale. carrier: #36910 (the epic's checklist-and-docs card).
- The designers' own auto-save (Data / Automations / Access pillars) is unchanged: out of this card.
